title: Fairy tales and fables
examples: Are fairy tales always true stories?
What is the difference between a fairy tale and a fable?
Where can I find more stories like this?

explain.say: We begin our story with a special phrase. Say, once upon a time.
This phrase tells us the story is not from today. It sets a magical time.
Fables are short stories with animal characters. They teach us a lesson.
Aesop was a famous storyteller. He wrote many wonderful fables for us.
A good moral is the lesson you learn from the story. It helps you live well.
For a real-life example, if you share your toys, you learn friendship is fun.

faq.q: What is the moral of the story?
faq.a: The moral is the lesson the story wants you to learn. It tells you how to act in life.
asks: What should I learn from this?

faq.a: No, fairy tales are made up stories. They are meant for fun and imagination.
Aesop was a very old storyteller. He is famous for his animal fables.

faq.q: What is the difference between a fable and a fairy tale?
faq.a: Fables often use animals to teach a clear lesson. Fairy tales are usually about magic and kingdoms.

faq.q: How do I find the moral?
faq.a: Think about what the characters did wrong or right. The good choice is usually the moral.
asks: How do I know the message?

facts: Fairy tales often feature magical elements like talking animals.
Fables usually have a clear moral lesson at the end.
Aesop is known for writing many animal fables.
The phrase 'once upon a time' starts many traditional stories.

quiz.say: The story of the Ant and the Grasshopper teaches us to prepare for the future. What is the moral?
quiz.why: This shows that planning is important for survival.

wrong.0: This is wrong because the Ant was thinking about winter.
wrong.1: This is not the main lesson shown in the story.
wrong.3: This is tempting because the Grasshopper was having fun.

quiz.say: Which type of story often uses animals to teach a lesson?
quiz.show: Fables use animals to teach lessons
quiz.why: Fables are specifically known for their animal characters and morals.

wrong.1: Fairy tales usually involve princesses and magic.
wrong.2: Myths are about gods and heroes, not usually animals.
wrong.3: Folktales are too general; fables are more specific.

quiz.say: When writing a story, what phrase signals a magical beginning?
quiz.show: Start phrase: Once upon a time
quiz.why: This phrase is the traditional way to start a fairy tale.

wrong.0: This is too plain and does not signal magic.
wrong.2: This sounds like a history report, not a story.
wrong.3: This tells us a specific time, not a magical time.
